title: Partnership Between Globo and Time Brasil TV Puts GE TV in the Spotlight
seoTitle: Globo and Time Brasil TV Partnership Spotlights GE TV
subtitle: The network expands the digital presence of Olympic sports through 2032
excerpt: The new alliance between Globo and Time Brasil TV brings Olympic content to GE TV, strengthening sports coverage throughout the Olympic cycle until 2032.
author: Daniele Morais
sourceName: Meio e Mensagem, Notícias da TV
contentHtml:
The recent signing of an agreement between Globo and Time Brasil TV, the official channel of the Brazilian Olympic Committee (COB), has made GE TV the primary digital gateway for Olympic sports. Valid through 2032, the contract ensures a constant presence of content, experiences, and commercial activations linked to the Olympic cycle.

Content distribution on GE TV

The agreement stipulates that Time Brasil TV productions will be broadcast across Globo’s platforms, including free-to-air TV, Sportv, Globoplay, and prominently on GE TV. As a result, the digital channel becomes the home of the project, offering videos, interviews, and coverage that extend beyond competition periods.

Play9’s involvement in production

Play9 Content Group, a company founded by Felipe Neto, serves as a strategic partner in content creation and influencer initiatives. The firm, which restructured into a group of four companies, remains a client of Play9 even after its founder departed from the ownership structure.

Coproductions and projects with athletes and creators

Among the planned initiatives are coproductions involving athletes, content creators, and brands. The goal is to generate narratives that keep Olympic sports in the spotlight, bringing disciplines and fans closer together throughout the entire Olympic cycle.

New commercial opportunities

The business model includes the sale of sponsorships, branded content, fan experiences, and events. The partnership expands opportunities for financial support for national sports, reinforcing the presence of the Time Brasil brand across various commercial fronts.

Impact on Globo’s sports coverage

With the integration of Time Brasil TV content, Globo expands its Olympic programming offering during peak audience windows. GE TV’s presence in the digital environment complements traditional coverage, allowing audiences to follow sports continuously and interactively.

With information from Meio e Mensagem, Notícias da TV.
